title: EVENTS & LIVE Cane Bar Catering
sub: Bring the theatrical experience of freshly pressed sugarcane juice to your wedding, celebration, or corporate gala across London and the UK.

pillars.title: LIVE ON-SITE EXTRACTION
pillars.desc: Fresh whole sugarcane stalks cold-pressed on-site in front of your guests within 30 seconds for theatrical aroma and taste.

pillars.title: BESPOKE VINTAGE BAR SETUP
pillars.desc: Hand-crafted rustic wooden bar stall with brass hardware, sugarcane stalk displays, and elegant botanical glassware.

pillars.title: CERTIFIED MASTER JUICERS
pillars.desc: Uniformed, 5★ food hygiene-certified artisans who interact with guests and deliver impeccable hospitality.

pillars.title: CUSTOM BOTANICAL CRAFT
pillars.desc: Fresh crushed garden mint, fiery ginger, Sicilian lemon, Himalayan pink salt, and custom mocktails curated for your occasion.

steps.title: CHOOSE YOUR OCCASION
steps.desc: Weddings, private milestone celebrations, corporate galas, or school festivals.

steps.title: LIVE ON-SITE THEATRE

steps.title: ENJOY UNFORGETTABLE POURS
